$comment: Files that belong to one machine or one person and must never be committed. Enforced by scripts/check-local-files.ts (CI check 'Forbid local files', tests/check-local-files.test.ts). Under /.github/ so CODEOWNERS makes a person read every change to this list. Patterns use Node path.matchesGlob syntax, matched against repo-relative paths with forward slashes.

forbidden.reason: Per-machine agent settings (Claude Code, Gemini CLI and others).
By convention a .local. file is per-machine, whatever its extension.
Secrets for one machine; only the .env.example template may be tracked.
Terraform state holds secrets and is per-environment.
